|game_text=Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except [[Control]]) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or place a card from hand under [[Credits Will Do Fine]]. |errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]. Other errata versions: [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB5-45-Master_Qui_Gon-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-45-Master_Qui_Gon.png]]) shows the original text (see [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]); the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-masterquigon-pre.gif]]) shows the PC-E2 text (see [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 2)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. Immune to Disarmed, You Are Beaten, and attrition.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The slip prints the take-into-hand icon (▲); the wiki writes it out (“take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”), as the card list does.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “Immune to Disarmed, You Are Beaten, and attrition.” to “Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition. May not be Disarmed.”. PC-E1 text: “Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition. May not be Disarmed.”<ref name="cl-1250_44-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 2)]]): Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata) (PDF created by 27 August 2012) moved “May not be Disarmed.” in front of the immunity: “May not be Disarmed. Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition.” The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the same text with a comma after “You Are Beaten” (a punctuation-only difference, not recorded as a version). PC-E2 text: “Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. May not be Disarmed. Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition.”<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-15; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announced earlier on the Players Committee rules forum; see the history above). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref><ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee posted this text on its rules forum on 21 March 2011, as an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook<ref name="pcforum-p608385">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 21 March 2011 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p608385 forum post])</ref>. That is earlier than the first archived copy of the card-list wording (PC-E1, 21 July 2012), whose own date is not known.
